title: Open One Decision With Its Evidence Chain
teaser: A result is stronger when the data path behind it can be reproduced.
full_text: For one critical decision record the input version transformation steps and final output as a single traceable chain.

title: Show the Last Verified State on Offline Launch
teaser: A cold start without network should not collapse into an empty unknown state.
full_text: Launch in airplane mode and verify that only the last locally validated state is rendered.

title: Persist the Normalized Name in a Numerology Fixture
teaser: Visually identical names can differ at the Unicode level and change mappings.
full_text: For one test name store raw input normalized form letter mapping and total together in the fixture.

title: Keep PDF Section Headings With Their First Paragraph
teaser: A heading stranded at the bottom of a page weakens a professional report.
full_text: Generate a long report and verify keep-with-next behavior across section boundaries and overflow cases.

title: Expose Destructive Restore Counts Before Replace
teaser: A replace restore should disclose its impact before any transaction is committed.
full_text: Compute the real diff and show counts for records to add change and remove in the restore preview.

title: Pin the Exact UTC Instant in a Transit Test
teaser: A local clock string alone is not enough to reproduce an astrology calculation.
full_text: Store the timezone identifier and exact UTC instant beside the expected transit result.

title: Re-scan the Same Screen at Large Text Scale
teaser: Layouts that pass at default size can fail badly for accessibility users.
full_text: Increase system text scale and verify fields errors and primary actions remain readable and reachable.

title: Block the Protected Calculation Itself for Free Users
teaser: Hiding a button does not prevent a guarded domain operation from running.
full_text: Invoke a PRO-only domain action directly under a Free profile and verify the entitlement guard returns no protected result.

title: Preserve Coordinate Precision Through a City Round Trip
teaser: Rounded coordinates can alter ascendant and house calculations.
full_text: Export and import a city fixture and verify latitude and longitude retain the contract precision.

title: Redact Birth Data From Diagnostic Logs
teaser: Troubleshooting output should not persist sensitive profile data unnecessarily.
full_text: Trigger a controlled error with synthetic birth data and verify date time and coordinates are masked in diagnostics.

title: Re-evaluate Entitlement After Lifecycle Resume
teaser: A purchase state changed in the background can invalidate permissions on the current screen.
full_text: Change entitlement while backgrounded then resume and verify the open screen reconciles to the latest state.

title: Do Not Silently Swallow Unknown CSV Columns
teaser: Schema drift should be visible instead of causing hidden data loss.
full_text: Import a fixture with an unexpected column and verify the contract produces an explicit warning or safe rejection.

title: Document the Exact Rounding Boundary of a Calculation
teaser: Different intermediate rounding points can silently change the final value.
full_text: Lock one calculation fixture with exact precision rules for each intermediate value and final output.

title: Keep TR and EN Independent Behind the Same Content Key
teaser: Locale parity requires matching structure without cloning the same prose.
full_text: Read one content key from both locales and verify placeholder parity while preserving independently authored text.

title: Validate SVG ViewBox Alongside Its Hash
teaser: A correct hash does not guarantee the asset will render inside the intended bounds.
full_text: Compare a packaged SVG viewBox dimensions and aspect behavior with its manifest contract.

title: Lock the Canonical Daily Message Header
teaser: New editorial batches must not drift back to the legacy column layout.
full_text: Accept only date locale title teaser full_text theme_tag for a new fixture and reject the legacy header.

title: Persist the PIN Attempt Counter Across Restart
teaser: A process restart must not reset brute-force protection.
full_text: Create failed PIN attempts restart the app and verify rate-limit state continues from protected storage.

title: Test a Notification Wall Clock Across DST
teaser: Notifications tied to local time can shift when UTC offsets change.
full_text: For a DST timezone verify scheduled instants before and after the transition while keeping the intended local clock time.

title: Use Exact Day and Night Boundaries for Planetary Hours
teaser: Rounding around sunrise can assign the wrong planetary hour.
full_text: Test the instant before sunrise the exact boundary and the instant after it against expected planetary-hour indices.

title: Verify an Empty-State Action Against Its Real Route
teaser: A polished empty state is still broken if its primary action navigates incorrectly.
full_text: Trigger the empty-state CTA with no records and verify the destination SCREEN-ID and return path.

title: Leave No Partial Plaintext After Backup Decryption Failure
teaser: A failed restore must not leave extracted sensitive data on disk.
full_text: Attempt restore with a wrong password and verify temporary storage contains no plaintext or partial extraction.

title: Test the BaZi Hour Pillar at the Local Day Boundary
teaser: Hour-branch logic around midnight can be corrupted by date conversion.
full_text: Bind 23:59 00:00 and 00:01 local fixtures to an exact timezone and verify the hour-pillar inputs.

title: Provide a Screen-Reader Summary for a Trend Chart
teaser: A visual trend without semantics excludes non-visual users.
full_text: Expose an accessible summary containing the metric period and primary change for a representative chart.

title: Protect In-Use Professional Presets From Unsafe Deletion
teaser: Deleting a preset referenced by an active consultation can break historical meaning.
full_text: Attempt deletion of an in-use preset and verify the contract blocks it or performs an explicit safe reassignment.

title: Scan Release Configuration for Test Keys
teaser: A disabled debug mode can still ship hard-coded staging credentials.
full_text: Automatically scan release config and string tables for demo test and staging key patterns.

title: Measure Contrast Systematically in the Fixed Theme
teaser: Even a single-theme product can place muted text below accessibility thresholds.
full_text: Validate contrast ratios for primary text helper text disabled states and links at token level.

title: Verify the Real Undo Boundary of Record Deletion
teaser: An undo affordance must match the underlying transaction semantics.
full_text: Delete a record then test the snackbar action against the committed transaction and allowed undo window.

title: Calculate Month Coverage From Physical Shards
teaser: Ledger totals should be derived from files rather than hand-entered counts.
full_text: Read both September shards and calculate the exact date set and thirty rows per locale.

title: Pair Both Locales by Exact Date
teaser: A total count can hide a day where one locale is missing.
full_text: For every September date verify exactly one canonical TR record and one canonical EN record using set equality.

title: Close September With the Next Exact Start Date
teaser: The continuation point should be explicit and machine-verifiable.
full_text: Record 2034-10-01 as the next start in the checkpoint and editorial ledger and reconcile it with physical coverage.
